newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean stocks soar 2.28 pct on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Chilean stocks soar 2.28 pct on foreign buying.

text.p: Chilean stocks soared on an influx of buying from overseas institutional investors, ending the first round of trade 2.28 percent higher at 132.85 points.
Brokers said the Chilean bolsa was reaping the benefits of an influx of money into Latin American emerging markets as stock indices elsewhere languished.
CTC A series was up five percent to 3,600 pesos on reports from Spain that its lead stockholder Telefonica de Espana was close to a merger deal with competitor VTR.
Electricity stocks, which often set the tempo for the Chilean market, were also up in feverish trade. Endesa rocketed four percent higher to 314 pesos, as did Enersis, up 4.4 percent to 293 pesos.
